name: Skyrim Modding Tools
description: Skyrim SE modding: records across a mod manager's load order, mods and patches authored as text and built into plugins, mods installed — the tools of skyrim-modding-tools-core under their own names.

modManager.description: mo2 (Mod Organizer 2) or amethyst (Amethyst, Linux). Unset: Mod Organizer when an instance is set, else Amethyst when it has Skyrim Special Edition set up.

mo2Instance.description: The instance folder, the one with ModOrganizer.ini in it; the tools follow its selected profile. Use a test instance: deploys write into its mods and profile.

amethystDir.description: Only if it is neither the Flatpak's nor ~/.config's: the tools find those.

winePrefix.description: Mod Organizer under Proton: the prefix it runs in, the folder with dosdevices in it. Found by itself for MO2-LINT.

crashLogDir.description: Where readCrashLog reads Crash Logger SSE's crash-*.log files. Unset: the SKSE folder in the game's My Games folder, where Crash Logger writes them.

projectsDir.description: Where the mod projects live. Unset: skyrim-modding-tools/projects in OpenClaw's state folder (~/.openclaw), which an update of the plugin leaves alone. Make it the modding agents' working folder too.

creationKitDir.description: For its Papyrus compiler and the vanilla script sources. Unset: the instance's game folder.

papyrusCompiler.description: PapyrusCompiler.exe, or russo-2025's papyrus-compiler on Linux. Unset: the Creation Kit's on Windows; on Linux papyrus-compiler on PATH.

nexusApiKey.description: Your personal key, from your Nexus Mods account settings. Without it the Nexus tools are not offered; downloadNexusFile only for a premium account.

profile.description: Which tools are offered: all (the default), core, or readonly.

maxResponseBytes.description: The ceiling on one answer; 0 removes it. Unset: the profile's.

capabilityGate.description: On (the default): a tool the backend cannot serve — the Nexus tools without a key — is not offered.

helperPath.description: A built SkyrimHelper. Unset: the one npm run build:helper builds.

agents.description: The agents that mod: they get the tools' instructions in their system prompt, and are asked to build a project they changed and did not build before they answer.
